native_range_geometry.point_rule: retain a GBIF occurrence only if its coordinate intersects at least one primary-native WGSRPD3 polygon for that accepted host species

gbif.page_selection: deterministic offsets from total count under the inherited relational-environment implementation; no extra pages after underperformance

insect_host_completeness.supported_host: host species passes exact taxon match and retains >=30 native-range occurrences after exact deduplication and 10-km thinning

selection_boundary: all_occurrence filtering and insect removal occur before palaeo host-resistance calculation and before any genetic nucleotide identity
host or insect retention cannot depend on a genetic response
request errors are technical incompleteness and must be resolved or the affected host remains unsupported; they cannot be relabelled ecological absence

next_step: After the exact WCVP narrow-host panel exists, acquire host occurrences under this rule and freeze the supported-host/insect ledger before any palaeo host model.
